title: Compounding in Your Head
problem: Estimate 1.01^70 without a calculator and give a reasonable error range.

hints.text: Use log(1+x)≈x for small x, so 1.01^70≈e^0.70.
e^0.693 is 2, and the correction log(1.01)<0.01 makes the true exponent slightly below 0.70.

solution.setup: Convert repeated multiplication into an exponential approximation.
solution.reasoning: Since ln(1.01)≈0.01-0.01²/2=0.00995, multiplying by 70 gives about 0.6965. This is slightly above ln 2≈0.6931, so 1.01^70 is just above 2, approximately 2.007. A mental range of 1.98–2.03 is well justified.
solution.finalAnswer: Approximately 2.01; a sensible mental estimate is about 2.
solution.sanityCheck: The rule of 70 says 1% compound growth roughly doubles in 70 periods.

keyInsight: Logarithms turn many small multiplicative changes into an approximately additive calculation.
recognitionCues: A power of 1 plus a small percentage suggests logarithmic or exponential approximation.
followUps: Estimate 0.99^100 and compare the symmetry of gains and losses.
